title: News attracts a buying funnel
hook: Two stated cases: explore attention separate from conditional purchasing.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How attention separate from conditional purchasing affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Purchases, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare attention separate from conditional purchasing in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Of 1000 toy visitors, fraction 0.8 stop and fraction 0.1 of those buy. How many purchases are expected?

claims.text: More attention at the top of a funnel need not mean more final choices. Conditional conversion and reach jointly determine the result. This comparison isolates attention separate from conditional purchasing.
